source_text: Quem proposuit Deus propitiationem per fidem in sanguine ipsius ad ostensionem iustitiae suae. Ut sit ipse iustus et iustificans eum qui ex fide est Iesu. Gloria Deo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Whom God set forth as a propitiation through faith in his blood for the showing of his righteousness. That he himself may be just and justifying him who is of the faith of Jesus. Glory to God. Amen.
pass_b_english: God [[put forward Christ as a propitiation by his blood, to be received by faith >> Bible:Romans 3:25]], to show his righteousness — [[just and the justifier of the one who has faith in Jesus >> Bible:Romans 3:26]]. Glory to God. Amen.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Romans.
anf_compare: no ANF for Rufinus Romans; do not copy Scheck FOTC
